title: Programmable Tokens (CIP-113), Mainnet Implementation Completed
description: Programmable Tokens (CIP-113), Mainnet Implementation Completed on Cardano: Potential and Challenges of Compliance Tokens with the Cardano Programmable Token The ability of Cardano's Programmable Token to bring about change in digital finance The Cardano Foundation announced on October 7, 2026, that the CIP-113 standard for Programmable Tokens had been implemented on the Cardano Mainnet. On the same day, the Swiss Capital Markets and Technology Association (CMTA) recognized a prototype implementation of CIP-113-based systems in its tokenized stock certification framework. What sets this development apart is not just the ability to issue new tokens. The key is the establishment of a foundation for verifying and applying rules to the process of token circulation.
